thread:
andrew: CI integ sanity turned red for hosted-api on shard 19. Failing tests: HostedStreaming::upgrade_flow, HostedToolcall::schema_validation, HostedAuth::jwks_rotation_assert. Job link: https://ci.redwood.engineering/ci/59823. Can someone rerun shard 19? tagging @maya @kevin

maya: On it. Rerunning shard 19 now.

sheridan-bot: Rerun requested by maya for job 59823 (shard 19). Queued.

andrew: Quick log snippets after first queued run: two callouts — 1) streaming upgrade shows "upstream closed without sending headers" (502) on POST /v1/chat/stream (upgrade). 2) toolcall schema validation fails with "missing required property 'tools[].metadata'" when the test harness validates tool responses. Thirdly, auth verify shows "InvalidSignature: kid not found" during JWKS verification. Pasting trimmed logs below:

```
POST /v1/chat/stream -> 502 upstream closed without sending headers
stream: read: connection reset by peer
---
ToolcallTest#schema_validation failed:
expected: {"tools":[{"id":"echo","metadata":{"owner":"test"}}]}
actual:   {"tools":[{"id":"echo"}]}
---
Auth verify error: TokenVerificationError: kid "abc123" not found in fetched JWKS (fetched keys: ["def456","ghi789"]) 
```

kevin: I merged auth header normalization last night but that shouldn't change JWKS lookup. @olivia do we have any JWKS rotations or CDN invalidation around 05:12UTC?

olivia: No planned rotation. Cloudfront logs show a brief spike in 5xx when fetching /.well-known/jwks.json ~05:12UTC — could be upstream CDN hiccup. If rerun passes it's likely transient.

maya: First rerun finished -> still red, same three failures. Kicked a second rerun (parallel).

andrew: Can we bisect narrow range? Suspect either PR #4821 (auth normalizer) or PR #4835 (tool serializer). Would like to bisect across recent merges.

kevin: I'll start a narrow bisect across the two PRs with the integration tag. Command I'm running: `./scripts/ci/bisect --range 2026-02-25..HEAD --tests "Hosted*" --shards 19 --parallel 4`. Will post job id.

maya: Bisect job created: 59845. Watching.

sheridan-bot: Bisect job 59845 started (owner: kevin).

olivia: Also please attach the exact request/response for the toolcall failure — that schema error suggests the test stub or serializer dropped the `metadata` field. If we have the raw HTTP exchange we can tell if harness or runtime mutated it.

andrew: Adding the minimal repro curl + response we captured from the harness (trimmed):

```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/tools/echo -d '{"input":"hi"}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer test-token"

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{"tools":[{"id":"echo","result":"hi"}]}
```

kevin: That response is missing `metadata` indeed. If the serializer used to attach metadata was changed in #4835, that matches. Bisect should tell us. If bisect blames #4835 I'll open a revert. Meanwhile I'll add a defensive test harness patch to tolerate missing metadata so other suites don't flare.

maya: Bisect progress: a few commits in the middle ran green, others red. I'll post final when finished.

kevin: FYI I'll also add a temporary extra JWKS fetch retry to avoid transient CDN spikes causing auth flake. Will put small PR up.

andrew: Thanks. If bisect points at tool serializer, we should prioritize rollback for the hotpath. @maya if bisect shows regression, can you escalate to oncall for rollback?

maya: :thumbsup: will escalate if bisect confirms.

maria (follow-up note posted as andrew on-thread): Bisect found suspect commit 7a3f2b (PR #4835) — changes touched tool response serialization. @kevin can you take ownership? I'll open a rollback PR if you're tied up.

kevin: I'm on it. Will triage the serializer change and push a revert or fix today. Thanks for the bisect run and the logs, that made it clear.

maya: Closing loop for now — watchers: I left links to reruns and bisect in the job doc. Will update when revert lands or CI stabilizes.
